Package com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.in.reporting

Class KfeTaxEventService

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.audit.adapters.in.reporting.KfeTaxEventService
@Service public class KfeTaxEventService extends Object
Produces user-scoped tax-oriented event views from KFE transactions and saved classifications. The output is an operational aid with an explicit notice, not a tax determination.

  • Method Details

    • list

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public List<KfeTaxEventResponse> list(Long userId)
      Lists up to 200 newest user transactions mapped to tax-event response records. Saved classifications override direction-based defaults.
      Parameters:
      userId - user whose transactions are listed
      Returns:
      newest-first derived events

    • export

      @Transactional(readOnly=true) public KfeTaxEventsExportResponse export(Long userId, String format)
      Exports the current derived events as CSV or a compact JSON array and includes the advisory notice. Any format other than CSV is normalized to JSON.
      Parameters:
      userId - user whose events are exported
      format - requested format, case-insensitive
      Returns:
      export metadata, content, and the source event list

    • classify

      @Transactional public KfeTaxEventResponse classify(Long userId, String eventId, KfeClassifyTaxEventRequest request)
      Saves or replaces one user's classification for a transaction-backed event. Event IDs may contain a suffix after a colon; only the UUID prefix identifies the transaction.
      Parameters:
      userId - owner of both the transaction and its classification
      eventId - event identifier, usually a transaction UUID
      request - requested user classification
      Returns:
      the event view using the newly persisted classification
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when identifiers/classification are missing or transaction is absent
